editDetails.howFilesAreNumbered: How files are numbered and where episode titles, descriptions and images come from. Changing this rematches only this show’s known files; watch history is kept.
editDetails.yourOwnTagsE: Your own tags, e.g. Not for kids
editDetails.onlyYouSeeThese: Only you see these. Use them to filter, build smart collections, or hide titles from a profile.
editDetails.unlockedUpdatedFromThe: Unlocked: updated from the internet on refresh
editDetails.lockedMovie: Anything you change is locked, so refreshing from TMDB won't undo it. Unlock a field to use the online value again.
editDetails.lockedSeries: Anything you change is locked, so refreshing from TMDB and TheTVDB won't undo it. Unlock a field to use the online value again.
editDetails.providerExplanation: The show’s details come from the library’s metadata provider, {{provider}}. Episode titles, descriptions and images come from the file episode order below.

editSeasons.pick: Pick a season to change its name or summary in the {{order}} order you’re viewing.
editSeasons.pickAired: Pick a season to change its name, summary or poster. Names and summaries change in the {{order}} order you’re viewing; posters show on home rows set to season posters.
editSeasons.locked: Anything you change is locked, so refreshes won’t undo it.
editSeasons.name: Name

episodeOrdering.changesBrowsingAndPlayback: Changes browsing and playback sequence. Changing File episode order selects its matching display order; you can then choose a different display order here. Changes apply when you save.
episodeOrdering.placesSpecialsBetweenRegular: Places specials between regular episodes when their position is known. Others stay in Specials; custom placements are kept.
episodeOrdering.fileOrderUnavailable: {{order}} is not available as a display order. Choose an available display order or retry the save.
episodeOrdering.partialSave: The file episode order was saved, but saving the display settings did not finish. {{error}} Retry to finish; Cancel closes this dialog without undoing changes already saved.

compareOrders.seeWhereEachOf: See where each of your episodes goes in another order before you switch. Your files aren't touched.
compareOrders.samePlace_one: All {{count}} episode are in the same place.
compareOrders.samePlace_other: All {{count}} episodes are in the same place.
compareOrders.differentPlace_one: {{count}} of {{episodes}} is in a different place.
compareOrders.differentPlace_other: {{count}} of {{episodes}} are in a different place.
compareOrders.stagedDescription: Compare where each episode appears. Choose Use to return your selection to Edit, then Save to apply it. Your files are not touched.
